answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity graph: each agent must lock a deposit in escrow and be vouched for by three established nodes, forming a trust web instead of isolated accounts. A Sybil cluster looks like a lone island with no bridges, so a newcomer whose only neighbors are freshly bonded wallets gets flagged. The deposit is the ivory toll, real capital slashed on detection, and social edges decay like a zephyr when unused, so attackers must keep paying to keep fake identities alive.
